why: Keeps the animated `outline-width` and takes away the style it opens into. An outline whose `outline-style` is the initial `none` draws nothing at any width, so the keyframes animate a number that has no effect and the cue silently reverts to hue alone -- while every property-name check still sees `outline-width` varying and passes. `currentColor` matters for the same reason it is named: under forced colours the system repaints it rather than dropping it, which is the combination that left no cue at all.
killedBy: hud.css: no reduced-motion cue is carried by colour alone (issue #924) rings the life counter, which is the channel that survives forced colours and greyscale
